certificate.source_clause: Execute a deterministic TMM optimization for a planar stack: Incident Medium Air (n=1.0), Layer 1 TiO2 (n=2.40, lossless), Layer 2 SiO2 (n=1.46, lossless), Substrate Glass (n=1.52, lossless). Illumination: Normal incidence (0 deg), s-polarization. Wavelength range: 450 nm to 700 nm, sampled every 5 nm. Objective: Minimize the arithmetic mean of power reflectance across the sampled wavelengths. Des
